segments.text: We first tried Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in 208. At the time, competition mattered because manual reconciliation wasted staff time.
The biggest issue was Trust in vendors. Without steady power in Port Harcourt, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Customer Relationship Management (CRM)—we saw Reduced stock-outs within 8 months.
Policy-wise, CBN cashless policy shaped our move. We adjusted by Use interns/NYSC.
Data helped; even a basic ML forecast gave us clearer demand patterns during Christmas.
